checkpoint.title: Celadon Game Corner and the Rocket Hideout down to B4F: the poster guard, the Lift Key Grunt, the LIFT KEY and B3F's Rare Candy

events.why: out of the Center's door (48, 11) (its ground floor coded, pokemon_center_room()), west along row 12, down column 41..43 to row 22, west to below the Game Corner (34, 21)
into the Game Corner, up the slot rows to below the Grunt (11, 2) in front of the poster
Rocket Grunt (TRAINER_TEAM_ROCKET_GRUNT_7): Raticate, Zubat Lv20; he runs off

a step north, where the Grunt stood: he walks off east and is removed before the script lets go (CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DefeatedGrunt), so the route planner's map still has him; the poster (11, 1) stops the player
the poster (11, 1): the switch opens the stairs (15, 2)
the stairs (15, 2) down to B1F, B1F to B2F (28, 2), round east of the turning Grunt (20, 6) (sight 2, all four ways) to (23, 4): the shortest way to B3F's stairs (21, 2) crosses his lines
west to (21, 4), a tile short of the Grunt's north line (20, 4..5), and up column 21 to the wall, onto the stairs (21, 2), whose warp is a step east
east off the stairs (21, 2) to B3F, onto its stairs (18, 2)

pokeguy's way through the arrow floor (video 56:39-56:50), a tap a tile: west along the top corridor and down column 12 to row 7, west to (5, 7), down to (5, 9) between the arrows; west onto (4, 9), which slides to the stop (2, 9); south onto (2, 11), which slides east to the stop (6, 11); west to (4, 11), down column 4 to (4, 14), west to the wall (1, 14), down to (1, 16); east onto (3, 16), which slides east and, turned by (7, 16), south to the stop (7, 20); west to (5, 20), down column 5 to row 25, east to column 15 and up to (15, 19), below the stairs to B4F (15, 18). He detours to the BLACKGLASSES on the way down column 5; we don't.
up onto the stairs (15, 18) to B4F (11, 15), round to (5, 3), east of the tile below the Grunt (4, 2)
Rocket Grunt (TRAINER_TEAM_ROCKET_GRUNT_18): Koffing, Zubat Lv21; he drops the LIFT KEY
a tile west, below the LIFT KEY (3, 2)
back to B4F's stairs (11, 15) and up them to B3F's (15, 18)
pokeguy's way back (video 57:39-57:42), a tap a tile: down to row 20, west to column 10, up it onto the arrow (10, 14), which slides a tile north to the stop (10, 13)
east along row 13 to the wall, below the Rare Candy (12, 12)
pick up the Rare Candy: two, with Route 9's
